latest_substantive_result.scientific_status: All new claims remain source_derived_unreviewed. Intake verified file preservation and retrieval only; no proof reconstruction, source-code execution, external review, novelty validation, or physical experiment is claimed.
latest_substantive_result.summary: N653 preserves the exact upper bound `F_e <= (1-q)^T+(1-(1-q)^T)4^{-k}` under an IID per-cycle global-replacer event. The source also computes a strong idealized echo suppression for a slow detuning profile, while documenting that echo is known work and that finite-pulse/full-gadget costs are omitted. No original QEC architecture survived its screen; tail-latency-robust universal non-Clifford scheduling remains open.
